integrity: Formal ten-state algebraic certificate and standalone exact Python verifier accompany the proof. No external or independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only monic and odd-monic Stern polynomials are enumerated exactly; the reciprocal count itself is only bounded. The 2016 Schinzel leading-coefficient chapter could not be read in full and may imply an equivalent formulation; priority remains qualified. No independent audit.
title: Tribonacci enumeration of monic Stern polynomials and a power-saving reciprocal bound
